scope: Two new independent game forms with original art, added to the existing catalog and routing. Existing worlds, visual editions and normal progress remain available.

trace: Started from the safe border and used an actual point-selected straight route to close the first region.
Observed 57.1% repair, moving enemy collisions and loss of a light core with unfinished line retraction.
Reload restored captured cells, repair percentage, player position and life count.
Completed through two further closures, ending at 83.4% with one core and three closures; reload retained completion.
Native narrow-screen direction, drawing-mode and retreat buttons were used at 390 x 844.
Global pause produced two pixel-identical canvas screenshots; fullscreen P pause, resume and exit were used.
swing: Cut first rope and observed a gravity fall into the first receiver, then entered the second scene.
Cut left rope while frozen, advanced seven ordinary 0.1-second steps, and observed projected landing 696 within the target mouth.
Cut remaining rope and resumed physics; actual second delivery completed both scenes, and reload retained completion.
Narrow-screen freeze, cut and step buttons worked; reload retained a cut rope and frozen in-flight state.
Dragged a real horizontal gesture across the rope; the rope was cut and the lantern fell.
Retried and used the canvas digit 1 key; one actual cut was recorded.
Default desktop fullscreen displayed the complete game scene, controls and independent exit button.
manual_browser_checks.comparison: Starting the right scene after the left scene paused the left: left control = 继续, right control = 暂停.

responsive.viewport: 390 x 844 browser override; actual viewport values and control measurements saved in assets/game-forms/gesture-qa/responsive-metrics.json
responsive.mobile_fullscreen_limit: With the 390px override, IAB native fullscreen screenshots showed a small scaled region. Layout dimensions were read, but these captures are not accepted as mobile fullscreen visual proof; fullscreen visual review uses the normal desktop viewport.

repairs: Actual browser caught a six-argument Canvas ellipse call. Added the missing rotation argument and strict drawing-double argument validation; independent subsequent tabs recorded no errors.
Added a direct canvas digit-key listener for numbered cuts, since the existing shared input helper does not collect Digit1 or Digit2.
Changed narrow-screen swing toolbar to two columns so long labels stay on one line with 46px controls.
Restored games report their retained scene/progress instead of repeating first-use instructions.
Closing a territory path now checks enemy contact before capture; a production-rule regression covers the closing-frame collision.

assets.art: Two original environment images and two isolated transparent props. Raw PNGs, full prompts, dimensions and hashes saved in assets/game-forms/gesture-generation-20261004.json.
assets.runtime: WebP encoding only with original dimensions and alpha. The attempted cradle background edit was discarded; the original was verified to have transparent outside pixels and is the runtime source.
assets.covers: Actual CUA canvas-region screenshots, then WebP encoding only; see gesture-preview-provenance-20261004.json.

known_parent_log: Comparison page still records the pre-existing unlocated MutationObserver observe(non-Node) error. No suppression was added. New standalone trace and swing tabs recorded empty error/warn logs.
limits: One territory mural and two rope scenes are demonstrations of distinct forms, not a long game or exhaustive genre taxonomy.
Lantern is a continuous point-mass pendulum with constraints and ballistic receiver detection; no claim of a general rigid-body or soft-rope engine.
Actual-device mobile performance and audio quality were not validated.
Other existing forms retain their prior verification scope; this batch does not claim all 49 forms were visually re-reviewed.
